title.en: I'd appreciate it if you could

es: Delegar con tacto usando I'd appreciate it if you could, Would you be willing to y It'd be great if you could, siempre con tarea y plazo.

teaching.en: I'd appreciate it if you could set up the tents before ten.
teaching.es: Te agradecería que pudieras montar las carpas antes de las diez.
teaching.explanationEs: I'd appreciate it if + you could + verbo base: petición cortés; could suaviza más que can.
segments: I'd appreciate it if you could
set up the tents before ten.
teaching.audioText: I'd appreciate it if you could set up the tents before ten.

teaching.en: Would you be willing to hand out the leaflets at the door?
teaching.es: ¿Estarías dispuesto a repartir los folletos en la puerta?
teaching.explanationEs: Would you be willing to + verbo base: pregunta que deja elegir a la otra persona.
segments: Would you be willing to hand
out the leaflets at the door?
teaching.audioText: Would you be willing to hand out the leaflets at the door?

teaching.en: It'd be great if you could finish the task by Friday.
teaching.es: Sería genial que pudieras terminar la tarea para el viernes.
teaching.explanationEs: It'd be great if you could + verbo base; by Friday marca el plazo.
segments: It'd be great if you could
teaching.audioText: It'd be great if you could finish the task by Friday.

teaching.en: Sara made a polite request, and Tom said yes at once.
teaching.es: Sara hizo una petición cortés y Tom dijo que sí enseguida.
teaching.explanationEs: Polite = cortés; la fórmula tentativa consigue que el otro acepte con gusto.
segments: Sara made a polite request, and
teaching.audioText: Sara made a polite request, and Tom said yes at once.

teaching.en: The deadline is Friday, so I'd appreciate it if you could send the list today.
teaching.es: El plazo es el viernes, así que te agradecería que pudieras enviar la lista hoy.
teaching.explanationEs: Deadline = plazo; puedes pedir algo antes del plazo oficial.
segments: The deadline is Friday, so I'd appreciate it
if you could send the list today.
teaching.audioText: The deadline is Friday, so I'd appreciate it if you could send the list today.

teaching.en: Would you be willing to help? It is only a small request.
teaching.es: ¿Estarías dispuesto a ayudar? Es solo una petición pequeña.
teaching.explanationEs: Request = petición; se puede suavizar aún más con only a small.
segments: Would you be willing to help?
It is only a small request.
teaching.audioText: Would you be willing to help? It is only a small request.

choices.text: I'd appreciate it if you could set up the tents.
You set up the tents now.

feedback.es: Solo la fórmula con if you could deja elegir a la otra persona; las demás son órdenes directas.

hint.es: La cortés usa una fórmula con if y could.

prompt.es: Completa: «Te agradecería que pudieras enviar la lista hoy.»

feedback.es: Con I'd appreciate it if se usa could, la forma suave de can, y después el verbo base.

hint.es: Es la forma suave de can.

origin.text: I'd appreciate it if you ___ send the list today.

prompt.es: Ordena: «¿Estarías dispuesto a repartir los folletos?»

answer.text: Would you be willing to hand out the leaflets

feedback.es: Would you be willing to + verbo base forma una pregunta que deja libre a la otra persona.

hint.es: Empieza con Would you be y después va to + verbo.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Sería genial que pudieras terminar la tarea para el viernes.»

answer.text: It'd be great if you could finish the task by Friday

feedback.es: La fórmula It'd be great if you could + verbo base termina con el plazo: by Friday.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué pide Mia y para cuándo.

choices.text: She wants Tom to buy gloves on Friday.
She wants Tom to set up tents at nine.
She wants Tom to bring gloves on Saturday by nine.

feedback.es: Mia pide a Tom los guantes para el sábado y los quiere a las nueve como máximo: el plazo es by nine.

origin.audio: Tom, would you be willing to bring the gloves on Saturday? I would like them by nine.

prompt.es: Completa las tres peticiones; la última fija un plazo (para el viernes).

feedback.es: Cada fórmula tiene su pieza: could tras if you, to tras willing y by o before para el plazo.

sentences: I'd appreciate it if you ___ call the school today.
Would you be willing ___ bring a spare tent?
It'd be great if you could send the list ___ Friday.

prompt.es: ¿Qué reescritura suaviza la orden «Bring the gloves by Friday»?

choices.text: Would you be willing to bring the gloves by Friday?
Would you be willing to bringing the gloves by Friday?
You have to bring the gloves by Friday.

feedback.es: Would you be willing to + verbo base conserva tarea y plazo con tacto. Bringing es incorrecto después de to, y have to expresa obligación, no una petición cortés.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué debe hacer Sara y para cuándo.

choices.text: Call the school and get an answer before the end of Thursday.

feedback.es: Sara debe llamar hoy y tener una respuesta para el jueves: son dos datos, tarea y plazo.

origin.audio: Sara, I'd appreciate it if you could call the school today. It'd be great if you could have an answer by Thursday.

prompt.es: Completa: «¿Estarías dispuesto a esperar al conductor?»

feedback.es: La fórmula completa es Would you be willing to + verbo base, una petición tentativa y cortés.

origin.text: Would you be ___ to wait for the driver?

prompt.es: Reescribe la orden como una petición amable con tarea y plazo.

answer.text: I'd appreciate it if you could clean the tables before lunch.
accepted: I'd appreciate it if you could clean the tables before lunch.
Would you be willing to clean the tables before lunch?
It'd be great if you could clean the tables before lunch.
I'd appreciate it if you could clean the tables by lunch.

feedback.es: Una orden se vuelve petición cortés con una fórmula tentativa, el verbo base, la tarea y el plazo intactos.

origin.text: Orden: «Clean the tables before lunch.» Conviértela en una petición cortés con una de las fórmulas de la clase.

choices.text: It'd be great if you could help.
It'd be great if you could be nice.
It'd be great if you could collect the bags by noon.

feedback.es: Solo esa petición dice qué hacer (collect the bags) y para cuándo (by noon). Las otras son amables pero vagas.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué le piden a Leo y cómo se lo piden.

choices.text: Leo is asked politely to set up the microphone.
Leo is ordered to set up the microphone.
Leo is asked to start the meeting at ten.

feedback.es: La fórmula would you be willing to es una petición cortés, no una orden; diez es la hora de inicio, no el plazo.

origin.audio: Leo, would you be willing to set up the microphone? We start at ten.

prompt.es: Completa: «Te agradecería que me avisaras antes del lunes.»

feedback.es: La expresión let me know significa avisarme; tras could va el verbo base let.

origin.text: I'd appreciate it if you could ___ me know before Monday.
